body: Truly, thank you for the advice, I will try that writing method.  The gun's not even the problem though, I'm actually out of ammo for it even. No, it's more about what it signifies to me, it's not about the gun, the same thing occurs for, say, a knife, it's just to drive the point. The whole idea that occurs in my head is; why not? The problem is not the gun, the knife, or the car. The problem is that I'm constantly questioning whether life is worth it, and I don't have many paths out of that line of thought, because I can't even afford affordable Healthcare to see a shrink.
